title: R4b restart service registration read contract
description: Closed central-only read of the current active restart service registration before the first inspection. Request names only the saved local case receipt; target device, tenant, revision, path and query are never accepted. Handler Result excludes the standard HTTP request_id; Response includes it. Strict UTF-8 ASCII JSON, no BOM/duplicate/unknown fields, depth<=8 and raw body<=16384 bytes precede schema validation. Shape is not current authorization, service registration, origin/pin provisioning or a new signing capability, and issues no receipt, operation, grant, inspection or pin.

ActiveRegistration.description: Unchanged R4b wire registration record restricted to state=active; revoked or absent registration is 403 SCOPE_DENIED, never null.

ReadRequest.description: Exact case and saved local case receipt IDs only. Identical body resent is a new read and is counted again.

ReadResult.description: Handler result. The client must not auto-migrate expected values; it compares with the saved R4a case baseline and local service before fixing the registration baseline.

ReadResponse.description: HTTP response: the standard wrapper adds request_id; this is not a business receipt or execution evidence.
